paper.title: Autoregressive neural Slater-Jastrow ansatz for variational Monte Carlo simulation
paper.authors: Stephan Humeniuk, Yuan Wan, Lei Wang

results.system_description: 4 × 4 square lattice, periodic; spinless t-V model, N = 5 spinless fermions, V/t = 0.01
results.variant: MADE autoregressive Jastrow with co-optimized Slater determinant
results.source_location: Table tab:L4Np5, row "arSJVMC (this work)", column V/t = 0.01
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the autoregressive Slater-Jastrow state (MADE neural network with a co-optimized Slater determinant), sampled exactly and autoregressively, for the t-V model with periodic boundaries.
results.notes: Total energy, as printed. Hamiltonian H_tV = -t sum_<ij> (c†_i c_j + c†_j c_i) + V sum_<ij> n_i n_j on the L x L square lattice with periodic boundary conditions (Eq. tV_Hamiltonian), the same as the instance. Transcribed from the cited location of the versioned arXiv source and checked against the printed token; curator review pending. Parenthesized uncertainties are recorded as reported, with their meaning left unspecified unless the paper states it.
